bio.text: Jacob Anders is an independent candidate for U.S. House in Tennessee's 4th District in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He was born in Huntsville, Alabama, graduated from Huntsville High School, and earned a bachelor's degree in psychology from Hiwassee College in 2016.
According to Ballotpedia, his career experience includes working as an author, historian, voice actor and political activist.
